name: feishu-plugin-sdk
description: Source of the feishu plugin: device-flow login completed in a hidden browser, the per-user token store, allowlisted Feishu API calls (the bridge other plugins call), and documents read as Markdown. Bundled into plugins/feishu/server/dist/feishu.mjs.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test test/*.test.ts && node ../package_plugin.mjs --check
